newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM sees steady first-half earnings.
newsitem.headline: DSM sees steady first-half earnings.

text.p: DSM NV said on Tuesday it expected results over the first half of 1997 to be comparable to those in the same period of 1996.
The company earlier reported full-year net earnings of 720 million guilders over 1996, down from 1.07 billion in 1995.
"In the markets that are important to DSM demand continues to develop favourably. As far as can be judged at present, margins, in particular those for polymers, will gradually improve," DSM said.
"Based on this, DSM expects that the results for the first half of 1997 will reach a level comparable to that of the first half of 1996," DSM said in a statement.
But it added it was too early to make a forecast for full-year 1997 results as it was not yet clear how economic growth, oil prices and currency exchange rates would develop.
